verdict.rationale: The evidence only implies an admin layer. A work or school account can use Gemini once "your administrator has enabled Gemini" [36], some features are restricted for work/school accounts [35], and chats and uploaded files in that context aren't reviewed by humans or used for training [38]. No admin console, member management, permission controls or configurable data policies are documented, so this is a glancing indication rather than real delivery. Missing for 10: member management, role/permission controls, admin-configurable data and retention policies, first-party admin documentation, independent corroboration.
